benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.estimate_basis: Award redeemable at hotels costing up to 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points, valued at 0.8 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. This is the award ceiling, not a typical redemption — record what the room actually cost to replace it.
benefits.merchant_scope: One night at a participating hotel with a redemption level at or under 35,000 points
benefits.notes: Deposited automatically each account anniversary; Chase allows up to 8 weeks for it to appear, so the real availability date can lag the anniversary shown here. The account must be open and not in default on the anniversary date.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary Silver Elite status, upgraded to Gold with $35,000 of annual spend. No dollar value is tracked.
